title: Everest Cumin Powder: one batch recalled for pesticide residues above limits
reason: FSSAI ordered a recall of this batch after residues of the pesticides azoxystrobin and thiamethoxam were found above permitted limits. FSSAI said the finding applies only to this batch. Details as reported by Business Today; check the source for the regulator's statement.

title: Patanjali red chilli powder: batch recall ordered for pesticide residues above limit
reason: In an order dated 13 January 2025, FSSAI told Patanjali Foods to recall a batch of red chilli powder because pesticide residues were above the permitted limit. FSSAI did not issue a public alert. News reports give the batch number inconsistently, so it is not listed here: ask the seller or the company whether your pack is affected.

title: Hong Kong and Singapore: ethylene oxide found in MDH and Everest spice mixes
product_names: MDH Madras Curry Powder, MDH Sambhar Masala, MDH Curry Powder, Everest Fish Curry Masala
reason: Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety found ethylene oxide, which IARC classes as carcinogenic to humans, in these products during routine surveillance and stopped their sale. Singapore's Food Agency ordered a recall of Everest Fish Curry Masala. In May 2024 FSSAI reported no ethylene oxide in the 28 Indian test reports on MDH and Everest samples it had received.
